themes.label: Decrees
themes.rationale: The text follows the standard formula for an Athenian decree, including the archon, prytany, secretary, and the formal enactment clause 'it was decided by the council and the people'.
themes.quote: ἔδοξεν τεῖ βουλεῖ καὶ τῶι δήμωι

themes.label: Honorific Inscriptions
themes.rationale: The primary purpose of the inscription is to honor King Pharnaces and Queen Nysa with golden crowns and bronze statues for their benefactions to the Athenian people.
themes.quote: ἐπαινέσαι μὲν τὸν βασιλέα Φαρνάκην καὶ στεφανῶσαι χρυσῶι στεφάνωι

themes.label: Accounts and Financial Records
themes.rationale: The text contains specific instructions regarding the allocation of funds for the statues and the travel expenses of the envoy, involving the military treasurer.
themes.quote: τὸ γενόμενον ἀνάλωμα μερίσαι τὸν ταμίαν τῶν στρατιωτικῶν

themes.label: Agonistic / Victory Inscriptions
themes.rationale: The decree specifies that the honors are to be announced during major athletic and dramatic festivals, including the Dionysia, Panathenaia, Eleusinia, and Ptolemaia.
themes.quote: διονυσίων τε τῶν ἐν ἄστει τραγωιδῶν τῶι καινῶι ἀγῶνι καὶ παναθηναίων καὶ ἐλευσινίων καὶ πτολεμαίων τοῖς γυμνικοῖς ἀγῶσιν

themes.label: Lists of Officials or Citizens
themes.rationale: The end of the inscription lists the specific citizens elected to oversee the construction and dedication of the statues.
themes.quote: οἵδε κεχειροτόνηνται Λέων Αἰξωνεύς Φιλόξενος Πειραιεύς Διονύσιος ἐκ Μυρρινούττης

themes.label: Stele
themes.rationale: The text explicitly orders the recording of the decree on a stone stele.
themes.quote: ἀναγράψαι δὲ τόδε τὸ ψήφισμα τὸν γραμματέα τὸν κατὰ πρυτανείαν ἐν στήλει λιθίνει

persons.name: Nysa
persons.role: Queen, wife of Pharnaces, honored benefactor

persons.name: Sosigenes son of Menecrates
persons.role: Secretary of the prytany from Marathon

persons.name: Octaius son of Simon
persons.role: Chairman (proedros) of the assembly from Athmonon

persons.name: Philoxenus of Piraeus
persons.role: Envoy and commissioner for the statues

places.name: Delos
places.type: Island and location of the monument

rationale: This is a significant Athenian honorific decree found on Delos, dating to the mid-2nd century BC (c. 160/159 BC). It documents the diplomatic and financial relationship between Athens and the Kingdom of Pontus, specifically King Pharnaces I and Queen Nysa. The text details the honors granted (crowns and statues), the festivals where these honors are to be proclaimed (Dionysia, Panathenaia, Eleusinia, Ptolemaia), and the administrative steps taken to ensure the decree's execution, including the appointment of a three-man commission and an envoy, Philoxenus of Piraeus.
